column2: Only users with Settings Service see Settings > Maintenance
Empty Maintenance settings page offers to create the first schedule
New schedule opens a blank "Untitled schedule" that stays open after Save
Save stays disabled until the schedule has at least one service
A schedule name cannot be left blank or reuse an existing name
The schedule's service table shows its columns and lets you reorder services
Schedule list has Active and Archived tabs, search and a row menu
Add service opens a blank service form with its fields in a fixed order
A service needs a time interval, while mileage and hours are optional
Interval can be "Every" or "At", and an "At" date uses a day-and-month picker
Units are written in full as "mileage" and "hours", never abbreviated
Interval boxes accept only whole numbers within the allowed limits
A service with several triggers comes due at whichever is reached first
Monthly intervals keep the same day, or the month's last day if missing
Choosing "Services also covered" pre-fills those services' canned lines
The form asks "Is this a compliance inspection?" before the trigger
Compliance Type is a required free-text box with example hints
Compliance Term and Remind before expiry are entered in months
A compliance service form has no certificate date and shows in orange
Add canned lines opens a searchable picker that shows each line's hours
A service shows no price, and hovering its line count lists the lines
Canned lines are optional, and later edits in Settings carry through
Reminder rows are in days and must be shorter than the interval
Reminder rows only set "due soon", and compliance services have none
Editing a schedule does not change assets already enrolled on it
Editing or removing a service asks first and leaves enrolled assets alone
Duplicating a schedule names it "(Copy)", then "(Copy 2)", with no assets
Archiving a schedule takes its assets off, and restoring adds none back
Remove from schedule takes one asset off and keeps its history
Enrolling an asset again counts from its last completion
The Enroll window opens from three places and lists every schedule
The Enroll window asks for the schedule, then optional last service dates
Enroll window shows certificates, missing readings and passed targets
Enroll several assets at once from the customer's Assets tab
The customer's Maintenance notifications switch takes effect at once
A notifications change made during enrolment stays if you cancel
Enrolling sends no email and puts due rows straight on the worklist
Compliance records appear in the asset card's Compliance section
Compliance record form: its fields, certificate number and attachment
Certificate Start date, End date and term fill each other in
The newest certificate is current, and a renewal takes effect at once
A compliance service with no certificate never comes due
Maintenance is the asset's last tab and offers Enroll in Schedule
Asset tab shows a recorded reading exactly and marks estimates
Asset tab lists services by due date, with the schedule as a column
The status badge shows only Due soon, Due today or Overdue
The Due cell shows the earliest date, other triggers are in the menu
Skip hides a service from the worklist until a new reading or work order
Due dates show a month when estimated and the End date for certificates
The worklist is the Maintenance reminders tab on the Customers page
Worklist tiles filter the list and count assets, not rows
Time tiles never overlap and combine with the Needs readings tile
Worklist shows 91 days ahead, with sorting, search and empty state
Worklist columns never change, and units show number, year, make, model
Invoicing or Mark complete clears the row from the worklist
Worklist due date shows confidence, Certificate or Calendar, not a figure
Create work order makes one estimate at the header location
Worklist row buttons are Contact and Create work order, the rest in a menu
Units on two schedules show a schedule chip on each row
Location column and location filter for shops with several locations
Compliance inspection chip filters rows, uncertified services sort last
Worklist keeps filters, shows cards on a phone and drops deleted assets
Contact card shows labelled phone numbers you can copy or tap
Send reminder emails about one asset and updates Last sent
Contact card reads correctly when phone, email or contact is missing
Send reminder is disabled when the customer's notifications are off
A "Last sent" date appears on the contact card after a reminder is sent
Maintenance changes are saved to the history (no screen shows it yet)
Adding a service to a work order adds a work order note
Correcting a reading keeps both values in the history
Sent reminders are logged with message, recipient and time
History is kept after removal, archiving and asset deletion
Changing the notifications setting is saved to the history
Monthly due dates keep the day, or move to the month's last day
Certificate End date is the Start date plus the term, same day of month
Remind before expiry defaults by the term and cannot exceed it
Confidence grade follows the reading's age and the number of visits
Confidence examples for mileage and hours, including No data
Worklist tiles: which days fall into each tile at the edges
Worklist tiles count each asset once per tile and follow the filters
Interval boxes accept whole numbers only, up to the exact limits
Enter mileage window shows the current and new reading for each meter
Saving a reading updates due dates at once and offers Undo
Every reading is kept with its date and source, and the newest is current
A reading typed on a work order shows "In the shop" until invoiced
Fix a wrong reading by entering the right one
The field reads "Mileage" and the unit is never shown as mi or km
An unusual reading asks for confirmation but is never refused
Readings come only from manual entry or work orders, not telematics
Unusual readings: gauge vs ECU, engine swap and same-day readings
The due date is the earliest of a service's triggers
A meter with No data gives no due date, so the calendar decides
At a reading or a yearly date: when it comes due and stays overdue
A compliance service is due on its certificate's End date
Confidence changes how the due date reads, not which date is chosen
A service resets others only if the shop named them as covered
Each service keeps its own row, and shared canned lines are added once
Today follows the location's time zone, and readings recalculate dues
Work orders from Maintenance show the schedule in the Work Orders list
A hand-made work order has an empty Maintenance schedule column
Adding a service keeps an existing Maintenance schedule origin
From maintenance filter shows the count and total of work orders
Email open rates and bounces are not tracked
Estimated reading is the last reading plus the unit's daily rate
The rate uses the last three reading intervals, or all if fewer
The rate ignores readings that are too close, lower, too high or too old
Correcting a reading updates the rate at once
Confidence shows Low, Medium or High, or No data
Estimated due dates show a month and confidence, not an exact day
How due dates read for mileage, certificate and calendar services
Mileage and engine hours each have their own confidence
Estimates round to 100 mileage or 10 hours, and the rate reads per week
Confidence hover explains the estimate and links to View work orders
Estimated dates never look certain, and Low reads "Soon" in the email
With no readings the calendar date is used and nothing looks broken
Work order Maintenance card starts collapsed with only a count badge
Covered services are folded under the service that covers them
Work order card rows show when each is due, compliance rows in orange
Hovering a service shows its lines, parts and form, never prices
Every row has an Add Service button that opens the Add Service window
Add a certificate or enroll the unit from the work order card
Typing Mileage on the work order updates the card at once
Two ways to clear a row: Add Service (on invoice) or Mark complete (now)
The work order card shows line count and hours, never money
After Add Service the row reads "Added · N lines" with Mark complete
Added canned lines appear as normal lines at the end of the work order
Add Service at another location charges this location's rates
Copied lines carry an internal note listing the home location's parts
Add Service shows Undo, and Remove works until the work order is invoiced
Work order card: line search, completing, invoiced and no-schedule cases
Splitting a work order or merging assets keeps services and history
Only the work order card offers "This work order" or "A new work order"
Create work order from the worklist shows the new number on the row
Adding a service writes one internal note naming service and schedule
A canned line shared by two services is added only once
Add Service needs permission and offers "A new work order"
Only completed work resets a service, never a declined estimate
Mark complete is in every row menu and resets from a chosen date
Mark complete asks where: On a work order or Completed elsewhere
Reset date cannot be in the future and Completed elsewhere needs it
Mark complete on a compliance service also records the certificate
Mark complete resets at once, but added lines reset only on invoice
Covered services reset together with the service that covers them
Invoicing shows "When was the maintenance done?" for added services
A closed line shows the date it closed, not the invoice date
Work done at one location updates the service at every location
When was the maintenance done? has a Compliance certificates section
After Mark complete: Undo toast, Completed row, off the worklist
Mark complete works without canned lines and shows no warning
Completing early needs no confirmation, and invoicing later changes nothing
The reminder email is sent only by hand with Send reminder
Send reminder opens the send email window listing every contact
The reminder email has fixed wording you can edit for this send
The reminder email lists every service the worklist shows for the unit
The reminder email shows the due month, or "Soon" for Low confidence
Reminder email sender, Reply-To and BCC copy
Reminder email greets one or two people by name, otherwise "Hello"
Reminder email footer says why it was sent, with no unsubscribe link
Notifications off blocks sending, and each send updates Last sent
Rate example: three intervals give 97.5 a day and the due month
Confidence grade for every reading age and number of visits
Confidence examples: visits and reading age together set the grade
An ignored reading lowers the confidence grade
Estimates round to the nearest 100 mileage or 10 engine hours
Readings older than two years are not used (No data)
Due date is the earliest trigger, and certificates are due on End date
Next due counts from the "Work done" date, not the invoice date
Mark complete on a work order saves its mileage and hours as readings
When was the maintenance done? appears before the payment window
Closing "When was the maintenance done?" after an edit asks to discard
Anyone who can invoice sees "When was the maintenance done?"
When was the maintenance done? cannot be reopened later
Past work order mileage counts as readings from release day
Mileage copied onto a new work order is not counted as a reading
Unit with nothing scheduled: email says "Nothing is scheduled yet"
Nothing due in 91 days: the email lists the next two as "Coming up"
Mark complete creates no work order and no Maintenance schedule origin
Users who can't open the schedule see its name as plain text
After a reset Remove is gone, and re-adding reuses lines still there
Reversing an invoice undoes its resets and asks again next invoice
Adding a line to a pending invoice asks again at the next invoice
Part sales and imported work orders show no Maintenance card
Every way of invoicing shows "When was the maintenance done?" once
Confidence changes exactly at 30, 90, 180 and 365 days
Each schedule shows its home location, e.g. "Lines from Calgary South"
Maintenance settings need only Settings Service, not Digital Inspections
The canned line picker lists the home location's lines
Users without access to the home location can't edit canned lines
Intervals of 14 days or less get no default "14 days before" row
A duplicated schedule keeps the original's home location and lines
The confidence hover ends with the estimate disclaimer
Mark complete in the row menu opens "Mark PM-A complete"
Where was it done? lists work orders from every location
Reset date defaults to today or the day the lines closed
Completed elsewhere needs a Reset date, shop and reading are optional
Mark complete on a compliance service records the certificate
Mark complete resets at once, but added lines wait for the invoice
After Mark complete: Undo toast, Completed row and Undo complete
Undo complete works only on the latest Mark complete
Mark complete on a work order saves its mileage as a reading
A completed row leaves the worklist until due soon (not Needs readings)
Create work order at another location adds the same work at local rates
Opening a work order from another location offers to switch location
New maintenance screens show loading, and an error with Retry
Hover cards open by keyboard or tap and close with Esc
Settings, the asset tab and enrolment work on a phone
View-only customer users can read the tabs but not change anything
Work order actions follow work order and invoicing permissions
Send reminder is offered when any of the customer's contacts has an email
